signals.evidence: Community coordinator (רכז קהילה) actively engaged in coordinating emergency response and community support in northern border community
צח״י (Home Front Command volunteer corps) mobilized and operating in community to support residents and coordinate with local authorities
Essential community services maintained despite security situation in northern border municipality
Community mobilizing material and human resources to support vulnerable populations including elderly and people with disabilities
Psychological support and trauma care services being accessed by residents in northern border community
Residents complying with shelter protocols when alerts (אזעקה) are sounded in northern border municipality
Shortage of individual safe rooms (ממ"ד) and public shelters (מקלט) reported in some neighborhoods of northern border community
Residents assisting elderly neighbors and people with disabilities (אוכלוסיה עם מוגבלויות) to reach shelters during alerts
Residents reporting cumulative burnout (שחיקה) and sleep disruption from ongoing security situation in northern border municipality
Schools and educational institutions operating on reduced schedule or remotely in northern border community due to security situation
Residents maintaining essential daily routines including work, childcare, and community activities despite security alerts in northern border municipality
Community organizing informal support networks and relief activities (הפגה) for residents without waiting for external direction
Residents receiving clear alert and shelter guidance from Home Front Command (פיקוד העורף) and local authorities in northern border community
